variant: Standard regular R8; not A8xx, Gmem, Sysmem, Autotuner or PowerMax variant

package_metadata.name: Mesa Turnip driver v26.0.0 - R8
package_metadata.description: Compiled from Source + unsupported gpu hacks
package_metadata.author: KIMCHI

driver_elf: ELF64 little-endian AArch64 ET_DYN, Android Bionic symbol versions (LIBC), HMI export

license_facts.mesa_core: MIT; individual Mesa components/files can have other licenses according to upstream docs.
license_facts.adrenotools_upstream: BSD-2-Clause (upstream driver.h, priv.h and driver.cpp SPDX identifiers).
license_facts.existing_winlator_helper_use: Only existing native ARM64 helper exports loaded for an isolated diagnostic; no helper binary copied into a distributed APK.

scope: Driver feature/image-format query only. No VkDevice, shaders, rendering, game boot, FPS, system driver replacement, APK installation, GUI, Wine/Box64 CPU runtime, or turbo.
reproduction_dependency: Current diagnostic dynamically loads installed Winlator 11.2 native GPU helper/hook libraries by exact hashes in the receipt. A standalone game APK would need its own correctly licensed adrenotools/hooks build and packaging; this diagnostic is not that APK.
